blurb: Fountain of the Sun is an 18-hole executive golf course with 4,224 yards from the longest tees and a par of 63. The course was designed by Red Lawrence and opened in 1971. It offers memberships, public play, leagues, outings, and a PGA HOPE program for veterans and active-duty military.
